name: Fujian Sunner Development Co., Ltd.
summary: Fujian Sunner Development Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the white-feathered broiler chicken business in China and internationally. It operates in two segments, Poultry Breeding and Processing, and Food Processing. The company is involved in feed processing, breeding stock cultivation, breeding and sale of generation chickens, hatching of eggs, broiler chicken breeding, broiler chicken slaughtering and processing, and sale of frozen chicken products; and production and sale of meat products and value-added fresh chicken.
